statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia

The service was to capture continuous rhythm data over an extended period
The service was to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes
The claim was denied under reason code CO-29
